name: moe_prescale_v1
hypothesis: Current Gluon W4A16 decode converts every E4M3 group scale to BF16 inside each output CTA/K tile. Preconvert scales losslessly once in untimed prepare, keep packed E2M1 codes, and remove repeated E4M3->FP32 scale decode from the hot loop; expected cost is a small scale-buffer expansion.
